title: Return two values in one row: (1) the short name of the home team that lost
question: Return two values in one row: (1) the short name of the home team that lost the fewest matches in the 2015/2016 season, and (2) the average heading accuracy of all players taller than 180 cm whose attribute records were logged in 2015.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  (
    SELECT T."XCL_174"
    FROM Match AS M
    INNER JOIN Team AS T ON M."XCL_013" = T."XCL_171"
    WHERE M."XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
      AND M."XCL_015" < M."XCL_016"
    GROUP BY T."XCL_171"
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS home_team_short_name,
  (
    SELECT CAST(SUM(PA."XCL_139") AS REAL) / COUNT(PA."XCL_128")
    FROM Player AS P
    INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P."XCL_122" = PA."XCL_130"
    WHERE P."XCL_126" > 180
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', PA."XCL_131") = '2015'
  ) AS avg_heading_accuracy

  (SELECT T."XCL_174"
   FROM Match AS M
   INNER JOIN Team AS T ON M."XCL_013" = T."XCL_171"
   WHERE M."XCL_008" = 17
     AND M."XCL_015" < M."XCL_016"
